name: spectrum-design-data
description: Adobe Spectrum design tokens, component schemas, and Spectrum 2 docs for Claude Code.

plugins.name: s2-docs
plugins.description: Skill: Spectrum 2 component documentation on-demand. Fetches S2 design guidelines, component options, and usage patterns without loading a persistent MCP server.

plugins.name: spectrum-design-data
plugins.description: Plugin: read-only Spectrum lookup (tokens, component options, mode resolution, guidelines). Bundles a pinned @adobe/design-data-mcp server with an embedded snapshot; needs Node.js >=20.12.0 and an initial npx download.

plugins.name: design-data-agent
plugins.description: Skill: spec-conformant design token lookup, validation, diff, and authoring for any custom dataset via the design-data CLI.
